name.zh: 史黛菈抵达并要求四对一
name.en: Stella Arrives and Demands a Four-on-One Match

periods.location: Osaka Bay Dome blue gate and battle ring
periods.summary: Stella arrives after Ikki's victory, apologizes for being late, and voluntarily requests a severe penalty: her delayed match against Mikoto Tsuruya will become Stella versus Mikoto plus the three remaining B-block Akatsuki representatives. Akatsuki accepts the favorable chance, but Stella's real goal is to force them to fight rather than arrange withdrawals later.
periods.cause: Stella's train delay makes Mikoto demand a penalty, and Stella refuses to let Akatsuki's B-block members leave the tournament unscathed after attacking Hagun.
periods.process: Committee chairman Yuzo Kaieda initially says immediate rescheduling is punishment enough, but Stella insists on stronger terms. Reisen Hiraga, Yui Tatara and Rinna Kazamatsuri join Mikoto on the field. Kaieda confirms that Stella must defeat all four, while Mikoto's side wins if any of them defeat Stella.
periods.outcome: A special four-on-one B-block match is approved and begins as the volume ends. Ikki realizes Stella is acting from anger for Hagun's injured friends and chooses to trust her.
periods.significance: Sets the next volume's immediate battle and shows Stella using her own penalty to strike back at Akatsuki's tournament strategy.
